def: a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good)

occurrences.text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
